description: The 49 city pages on yourfinancejob.com (london, newyork, amsterdam, frankfurt, zurich, singapore, hongkong, ...), by region, each with today's open roles, hiring firms, the busiest firms there, upcoming events and a link. search_jobs city=<slug> gives a city's roles, list_events city=<name> its events, save_list city=<slug> keeps it; `saved` says which the member keeps.
